projects.title: Steel Quoter
projects.summary: A Windows desktop application for measuring structural steel drawings imported from PDF files, using the PDFTron library. Records measurements to support review and error tracking.

media.caption: Start a new measurement project or open an existing drawing.
Member schedule alongside the structural drawing for measurement review.
Detailed drawing view with recorded member measurements.

contributions: PDF drawing import and display using PDFTron, with a canvas for measuring structural steel members.
Measurement recording and quality reports for reviewing steel drawings.
projects.outcome: Helps engineers cross-check steel measurements and identify discrepancies during drawing review.

projects.title: HKHS Data Migration
projects.summary: A data migration application that consolidates MySQL and Oracle databases into a single MySQL database, with a standalone viewer for reviewing reports.

media.caption: Report viewer with record filters, export, and print options.

contributions: Consolidation of MySQL and Oracle source databases into a single MySQL database.
A standalone report viewer for reviewing records.
projects.outcome: Brings records from two database systems into one destination, with reports available for review.

projects.title: HKSP Interactive App
projects.summary: An interactive 3D experience of Hong Kong Science Park, built with C# and Unity 3D. Uses Xbox Kinect to let visitors explore the park through gesture controls.

media.caption: Demo of the Science Park installation using Kinect gesture controls.

contributions: An interactive 3D application built with C# and Unity 3D.
Xbox Kinect gesture controls for exploring the Hong Kong Science Park model.
projects.outcome: Lets visitors explore a 3D model of the park through physical gestures.

projects.title: LogTag
projects.summary: An Android application that connects to LogTag devices over Bluetooth, enabling users to send and retrieve device data from their phones.

media.caption: Welcome screen for connecting to a LogTag device.
Device list with data retrieval and configuration options.
Chart summary displaying recorded device data.

contributions: Bluetooth communication between the Android application and LogTag devices.
Device data transfer and retrieval through a mobile interface.
projects.outcome: Lets users interact with LogTag devices and retrieve their data from an Android phone.

projects.title: HKMuseum App
projects.summary: A mobile museum guide featuring artifact descriptions, image galleries, exhibition details, and visitor information to help users plan their visits.

media.caption: Exhibition welcome screen with language selection.
Tomb Explorer content within the museum guide.
Plan your visit with location, opening hours, and ticketing information.

contributions: A mobile guide with artifact information, exhibition content, and image galleries.
Visitor information covering opening hours, ticketing, and location.
projects.outcome: Gives museum visitors a way to explore exhibition information and plan their visit.

projects.title: Lingao Golf Teaching App
projects.summary: An iOS golf coaching application with video recording, visual annotation, and cloud uploads to support instruction and technique review.

media.caption: Welcome screen for the Lingao golf coaching application.
Coach and student sign-in before a coaching session.
Video library with options to capture and upload recordings.

contributions: Golf video recording and on-video drawing tools.
Cloud uploads for recorded coaching videos.
projects.outcome: Supports golf instruction with recorded videos and visual annotations for technique review.

projects.title: DPET
projects.summary: An iOS application that uses augmented reality to measure a child’s height and identify corresponding weight and color zones. Displays dosage reference information for pediatric emergency care.

media.caption: Reference information and disclaimer before using the measurement tools.
Camera interface for starting a height measurement.
Animated demonstration of the augmented reality measurement interface.

contributions: An augmented reality measurement workflow built for iOS using Swift 4.2.
Height-based weight and color zones with pediatric dosage reference information.
projects.outcome: Combines height measurement and pediatric emergency reference information in a mobile application.

projects.title: UControl
projects.summary: A mobile and tablet application developed in-house for controlling building systems in malls and hotels. Connects to hardware controllers to manage air conditioning, lighting, curtains, and other connected equipment.

cover.alt: UControl mobile interface for controlling air conditioning

media.alt: UControl mobile interface for controlling air conditioning
media.caption: Mobile air conditioning controls for temperature, mode, and fan speed.
Tablet sign-in screen for the UControl application.
Video demonstration of the UControl application.

contributions: Mobile and tablet interfaces for controlling air conditioning, lighting, and curtains.
Communication with hardware controllers as part of an in-house building control application.
projects.outcome: Lets users control connected building equipment in malls and hotels from a phone or tablet.

projects.title: Tomorrow Super
projects.summary: A web application for managing Australian superannuation accounts, built with React and .NET. Includes account registration and investment strategy selection.

media.caption: Demo of account registration and investment strategy selection.

contributions: An Australian superannuation account management application using React and .NET.
Account registration and investment strategy selection workflows.
projects.outcome: Lets users register accounts and select investment strategies through a web interface.
